title: Not as well made as their other design that has a double door...
text:
Not as well made as their other design that has a double door.... THE GOOD:
--------------
* This one has a larger 56L capacity compared to it's 42L cousin.
* Dimensions are 20.66x13.85x11.22 when fully opened.
* Dimensions are 20.66x13.85x2.44 when folded flat.
* Packs flat, collapsible if you need to put it away.
* Stackable simply because of the flat tops. There are no special connectors.
* The wooden accent piece as a lid is a nice aesthetic touch, but it's actually MDF.

THE BAD:
------------
* No double door design, but that's why it's not $72.
* The frame design is either bad engineering, or there are some QC issues. The partitions do not connect well to the bottom panels. They keep popping out. I suppose with a lot of things placed in the box, this would then force them to stay connected. Still, at $40 a pop, you don't want to see these issues. Because there are collapsible crates at Costco that don't cost this much. So if you want to charge a premium, you need to get this right. Overall, this one is 3-Stars.
